steps.note: Search for the first value ≥ 2. Range 0..4.
arr[2] = 2 qualifies — record position 2, but a better one may lie left: search 0..1.
arr[0] = 1 doesn't qualify — the answer is to the right: search 1..1.
arr[1] = 2 qualifies — record position 1, but a better one may lie left: search 1..0.
Lower bound of 2 is index 1 (value 2). That is also where to insert it to keep the order.
